## Contribution checklist

- [ ] I own this contribution or have permission to submit it.
- [ ] I agree that teaching content will be released under CC BY 4.0 and code
      under the MIT License, as applicable.
- [ ] I have not included material from the ignored reference or solutions
      directories.
- [ ] I have provided the public name or handle and contribution description I
      want recorded in `CONTRIBUTORS.md`, or I have stated that no public credit
      is requested.
- [ ] I read `AGENTS.md` and `SPEC.md` and checked the applicable content and
      accessibility requirements.
- [ ] I ran `nix flake check` and inspected the generated public artifact.
